title: My Building Has No 13th Floor. The Elevator Stopped There Anyway…
hook: My building has no 13th floor. The elevator stopped there anyway.
story: My building doesn't have a thirteenth floor. Last night, the elevator stopped there anyway. It was around midnight, and I was riding up alone. The buttons go twelve, then fourteen, like in a lot of old buildings. But the screen above the door said thirteen, and the doors slid open. The hallway looked exactly like mine. Same carpet. Same ugly lamps. Same plant by the window. Except every door was open, and every apartment was empty. No furniture. No people. Just the lights on. And at the end of the hall, one door was closed. Fourteen-oh-six. My apartment number, on a floor that doesn't exist. I stood there pressing the close button over and over, and the elevator wouldn't move. Then, from behind that closed door, I heard my own phone ringing. My ringtone. I checked my pocket. My phone was in my hand. The doors finally closed, and the elevator carried me up to fourteen like nothing happened. This morning, I told the building manager. He laughed, until I described the plant by the window. He stopped laughing. He said that plant was removed from every floor ten years ago… after the last tenant of fourteen-oh-six went missing. Tonight, I'm taking the stairs.
description:
Always take the stairs. 🛗
